tenderSchedule.title: Providing pre-recuritment Residential Skill Training to minority Category candidates to join various i.e., Indian Army. under two cover system / two parts (Technical and Financial Bid) from registered training Institutions who have adequate resources and experience.
tenderSchedule.description: The department intends to conduct provide pre recruitment Residential Physical Skill Training to Minority Caste candidates to join various Skilled Defense or uniform services i.e. Indian army, Air force, Navy, CISF, BSF, RPF, Police, Excise etc. The bidder should have adequate human resources, infrastructure, Study material, and experience to effectively implement the said training program. The bidder should conduct residential training to Minority category candidates

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Directorate of Minorities, Maulana Abul Kalam Aazad Bhavan, No.16 C, Millers Tank Bed Area, Vasanth Nagar, Bangalore-560 052.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All the terms and conditions mentioned under the tender document will be applicable

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The candidates who have undergone (full time - complete course) training from the bidding coaching institute must be selected to the Defense Services during the last 3 notifications/Years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The bidder should furnish all the below documentary proof and details as per the format enclosed at Annexure 1 (should be in affidavit with notary)
Others -- The result sheet of Students who have secured appointment in various posts of Defence Services Exams
Others -- Admission details of the students studied in respective coaching institute, such as fee paid receipt/ institute id card

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Coaching institution should have trained students through offline mode (full time complete course) for Defence examinations during the last 3 years. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Coaching institution should have 5 full time trainers of DEFENSE/PARA MILITARY OFFICERS/ permanent retired JCO / NCO rank officers / Staff in any Defence force ON PAYROLL for Physical Training with a minimum of 5+ years of teaching experience in Karnataka State Police or Allied Civil Services examinations

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have a gated/fenced training center (owned or leased or rented) -Minimum 3 Classrooms with (Audio/Video Facility) for coaching with also library, medical inspection room with bed facility, CCTV surveillance, accommodation, Emergency ambulance vehicle & Nursing Assistant at night.- Hygienic kitchen and mess with FSSAI approved vendor and kitchen.- physical training should be within the same campus. with minimum 3 acres of ground having for, running track and physical training equipments like Zig Zag, high jump, long jump, 8 feet wall etc. Facilities available for endurance Test Training with 10 obstacles & above

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: GST Registration

Others -- Geo-location (Google Maps link or coordinates)
Others -- GPS Photographs of premises (Exterior, facilities available for endurance test training & Interior)
Others -- FSSAI Certificate
Others -- Details of classrooms and seating capacity
Others -- Availability of essential utilities (electricity, water, internet, washrooms)
Others -- All accommodation and associated training facilities shall be located within a 500-meterradius of the designated training/classroom premises.

itemList.itemName: The training institute should quote training fee per candidate, including cost of training for 60 days, cost of boarding and lodging, cost of insurance coverage, one pair of shoes & Socks, track suit and all necessary statutory Taxes, other incidental expenditures and deductions such as TDS and GST.
